saw_lines: Party buyers shop against a date. They grab a costume or decorations for one night, so the deadline decides the sale.
So the sale is won or lost in line one, then the homepage has to carry the buyer to a product.
Your 5 of 13 copy ads run the same copy, so the pitch repeats. Keep the copy, but change the opening line and creative in each of those five ads.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Five of your 13 copy ads run one exact copy, so buyers see the same pitch five times. Keep the body of that copy, rewrite the opening line in each, and shoot a different costume or decoration for each ad.
No proof number in your ads

None of your 26 ads shows a checkable proof number. The 500.000 happy customers line has no review count or orders shipped behind it, so it reads as a slogan. Collect one count and open two ads with it.

Five of your 13 copy ads open on the same halloweendeals line, so the account leans on one hook. Test two new angles against it, a costume range push and a party theme push, then keep the stronger opener.
11 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, not the product shown. A buyer who clicked an ad lands among mixed sections and has to search. Point each ad to its own product page.

ads_1: Costume and party-theme openers replace the halloweendeals line, one product per ad.
